elementor_matches.value: Located in Miami, Florida, SABER College has been preparing students for rewarding healthcare careers since 1972. Our programs include the Professional Nursing Program (PNP), the Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) Program, the healthcare training Program and English for Speakers of Other Languages (VESL). Each program is designed to provide students with the skills, knowledge, and professional readiness needed to succeed in the healthcare industry.

Our healthcare programs are delivered entirely in English, ensuring that graduates meet the language and communication standards required in medical environments across the United States. For students who need to strengthen their English proficiency before enrolling in a healthcare program, our VESL course offers a supportive, academic setting focused on language development.

Whether you’re interested in learning more about our Nursing labs, PTA clinical training, or VESL classroom activities, our gallery offers a real glimpse into day-to-day campus life. It’s not just about posed photos or promotional images. Our Instagram posts reflect real moments—students participating in lab simulations, collaborating in group projects, engaging in community service, and celebrating their academic milestones.

English for Speakers of Other Languages

elementor_matches.value: As part of our commitment to accessible, career-driven education, SABER College offers select courses and program components via distance education. This includes the entire English for Speakers of Other Languages (VESL) program, delivered 100% online, and the first semester of our accredited healthcare programs, including Professional Nursing and Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA). After this initial online phase, healthcare students transition to on-campus instruction for the hands-on and clinical components of their training.
{"$$type":"classes","value":["e-de-vesl-card"]}
Online VESL Program

Our Online VESL program is delivered entirely through distance education, allowing students throughout the State of Florida to build their English proficiency from the convenience of home. The curriculum emphasizes reading, writing, grammar, listening, and speaking, and is taught by experienced instructors who provide live sessions, structured assignments, and individualized feedback. The program is ideal for adult learners who want to improve their English before entering a degree, certification, or job training program.

From your first inquiry to program completion, you’ll have access to responsive staff and qualified faculty who are committed to helping you stay informed, confident, and connected. This structured support ensures that every student participating in SABER College distance education—whether for a full program like VESL or a short-term component of a healthcare track—has the tools and resources needed to succeed.
Designed for Access and Impact
